title: Design a Distributed Time-Series Metrics & Alerting System
summary: Design a planetary-scale time-series metrics collection, real-time aggregation, dashboard querying, and alerting platform handling millions of data points per second.
description: Design a scalable, highly reliable distributed time-series monitoring and alerting platform similar to Prometheus, Datadog, or Thanos. The system collects numerical metric data points with dynamic labels/tags from tens of thousands of client servers, containers, and microservices. It must support high-throughput write ingestion, time-series compression (e.g., Gorilla XOR and delta-of-delta encoding), multi-resolution retention with downsampling, high-cardinality label indexing, sub-second dashboard queries, and real-time threshold and rate-of-change alert rule evaluation with deduplication and escalation.
functional_requirements: Ingest metric data points formatted as (metric_name, timestamp, value, tags/labels) via HTTP, gRPC, and push/pull agent collectors.
Query historical and real-time time-series data with aggregations (sum, avg, p50, p95, p99, rate, irate) over custom time windows and downsampled resolutions.
Define dynamic alerting rules (static threshold, rate of change, absent metrics) evaluated periodically (e.g., every 15-60 seconds).
Dispatch alert notifications to configured notification channels (PagerDuty, Slack, Webhooks, Email) with alert state transitions (Firing, Resolved, Silenced) and deduplication.
Provide multi-tenant metric namespace isolation and role-based access control for query and alert definition.
non_functional_requirements: Ultra-High Ingestion Throughput: Ingest >= 1,000,000 metric data points per second with P99 ingestion latency under 50ms.
Interactive Query Latency: P95 query execution time strictly under 500ms for standard 24-hour dashboard visualization panels.
Durability & High Availability: 99.99% ingestion uptime with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and multi-node replication to prevent data loss.

Storage Efficiency & Downsampling: Achieve >= 10x storage compression via Gorilla delta-of-delta timestamps and XOR floating-point value compression, transitioning raw 10s data to 1m resolution at 7 days and 1h resolution at 30 days.
Alerting Reliability & Near Real-Time Evaluation: Alert rules evaluated within 15 seconds of metric ingestion without missed alerts or notification storms.
key_challenges: High write throughput and out-of-order data point ingestion handling without locking bottlenecks.
High-cardinality tag explosion: Preventing inverted index bloat and excessive memory consumption when developers add dynamic labels like user_id or IP address.
Time-Series Data Compression: Implementing Gorilla encoding (double-delta timestamp compression and XOR floating-point value compression) to reduce raw 16-byte pairs down to ~1.37 bytes.
Tiered Downsampling Pipeline: Asynchronously computing rollups (min, max, sum, count, avg) across time blocks and migrating data from fast NVMe SSD storage to cost-effective S3 object storage.
Scalable Alert Evaluation: Partitioning tens of thousands of alert queries across worker fleets to prevent evaluation delays and eliminating flapping alerts using duration windows (for 5m).

reference_solution.architecture_pattern: Distributed Time-Series Database (TSDB) with decoupled ingestion buffer, streaming metric indexer, tiered storage engine, and distributed alert rule evaluation workers
core_components: Edge Agent Collectors & Push Gateways scraping metrics at 10s intervals and buffering in local memory
Stateless Ingestion Gateway fleet routing metric batches using consistent hashing on series hash
Kafka / Redpanda Ingestion Buffer decoupling bursty write traffic from TSDB storage nodes
TSDB Storage Engine (Thanos/Cortex/Prometheus architecture) maintaining in-memory 2-hour head chunks backed by Write-Ahead Log (WAL)
Inverted Index Service mapping label pairs (e.g., service=payment, region=us-east) to 64-bit series IDs
Compactor & Downsampler Worker fleet consolidating 2-hour immutable blocks into daily chunks and generating 5m/1h rollups for S3 object storage
Distributed Query Engine distributing PromQL/M3QL queries across in-memory cache and object storage
Alert Evaluation Engine evaluating PromQL alert expressions on scheduled ticks and routing to Alertmanager
reference_solution.compression_strategy: Gorilla double-delta timestamp compression with variable-bit encoding and XOR floating-point mantissa/exponent bit-packing achieving ~1.5 to 2.5 bytes per sample.
reference_solution.high_cardinality_mitigation: Enforcing server-side cardinality quotas per metric name, dropping volatile labels at the ingestion gateway, and storing inverted index postings in Roaring Bitmaps.
